globalPassRequires: Every required case with verified fixed suite proof AND actually implemented structured joined-chain evidence; C35/C36 required until real later evidence.
phaseSelfTestScope: Runner infrastructure only; never a global case PASS or SDK_READY claim.

proofs.suiteScope: TASK_LOCAL; reviewed imports preserve original argv/cwd/logs, explicit UNMEASURED binary identity, schema-fixed Cargo targets, and SHA1 Git commit/tree/blob plus SHA256 source/report bindings. Reconstructed checkpoint inputs are not labelled historical capture.
proofs.chainPolicy: JOINED_CHAIN_PROOF_V1: fixed source closure plus measured raw execution/log/artifact hashes and chain-specific structured comparisons. Missing material remains NOT_RUN; PASS labels, test names and declarations alone never suffice.
